capabilities: list backlinks the current note does not link back to in a right-sidebar pane
toggle between One-way and Paired backlink lists with counts
insert a link back to a referring note at the end of the note (Pro)
hide backlinks from notes in specified folders and subfolders (Pro)
extras: Freemium: core features are free and never write to notes; Pro (Link back, Hidden folders) requires a GitHub Sponsors sponsorship and sign-in via the GitHub device flow. Desktop only (did not show in the mobile drawer) and needs Obsidian 1.13.4+. After updates it opens a What's new tab promoting other NoteMods plugins and Zovo Chat; no telemetry and no note content is sent.
intentEvidence: The core pane has no setting or API for this filter, so the plugin adds its own pane.
motivation: The author built it to answer a forum request for an option to show only non-reciprocal backlinks.
problem: The core Backlinks pane lists every note that links to the current note, including ones it already links to, so unfinished connections are hard to spot.

requires.name: GitHub Sponsors sponsorship of theluckystrike ($5/month or $15 total)

summary: Sidebar pane that lists backlinks to the current note that the note does not link back to, with a toggle for paired backlinks.
